messages:
maya_pm: Quick sync to lock SDK/docs/runtime launch criteria for tool-calling + structured outputs before roadmap freeze. List blockers and owners.
dan_ts: TS needs a typings shim + migration lint. Plan: export `tool_calling` and keep `function_call` alias for one release, add `tsd` tests.
anna_py: Python will mirror with `client.tool_call` + alias `client.function_call` emitting DeprecationWarning. Add unit test for alias.
ren_docs: Docs: one canonical example per language, migration guide, compatibility matrix, and a small frontpage notice.
taylor_devex: I'll create changelog template and CI gating check that requires migration snippets before merge.
sasha_runtime: Runtime will normalize `function_call` -> `tool_calling` and emit header `X-Deprecation: function_call; removal=2026-07-01`. Schema validation = opt-in by org flag.
maya_pm: Launch gates (must have before freeze): SDK published with alias + tests, docs updated with canonical examples + migration guide, runtime mapping + header deployed to staging, partner comms + legal sign-off, CI checks green. Owners assigned: Dan (TS), Anna (Py), Ren (docs), Taylor (changelog/CI), Sasha (runtime), Maya (partner/legal).
dan_ts: I'll open TS PR today and add a `--compat` flag to keep old name locally for testing.
anna_py: Py PR started; will include DeprecationWarning and docs snippet.
ren_docs: Will draft canonical examples page and wait for TS types to land. Will standardize `structured_output.metadata` as `Record<string, unknown>` with recommended keys: source, score, schema_version.
taylor_devex: Changelog fields: change, impact, migration, deprecation_date, tests. CI will fail if migration snippet missing.
sasha_runtime: Runtime PR in review; ETA Thu staging. Will include tests that assert header present when legacy key used.
maya_pm: Decision: canonical SDK property = `tool_calling` (SDK v2). Server accepts legacy `function_call` and maps it. Deprecation header until 2 major releases after v2. Default schema validation = off; opt-in per-org. Update your PRs and ping me when ready.
release-bot: release/cut status: no blocking PRs detected for project "tool-calling".
maya_pm: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Friday for final sign-off. :rocket:
